title: Boynton Beach Boat Rentals
specs: Located at Boynton Harbor Marina along Ocean Avenue and the Intracoastal Waterway
Operators born after January 1, 1988 must have proof of approved Boating Safety Course or valid boating license
Must know how to safely operate the watercraft being rented
Florida law: Must be 16 years old to operate rental watercraft with proof of boating course or boating card
Persons born before January 1, 1988 are exempt from boating card
Boat capacities: 23 Ft. Deckboat up to 6 passengers, 24 Ft. Deckboat up to 8 passengers, 25 Ft. Center Console up to 10 passengers
includes: Boat, fuel and captain included in charter cruise
gap: Exact fuel and tax charges not stated
blurb: Guests can rent boats including 23 Ft. Deckboat, 24 Ft. Deckboat, and 25 Ft. Center Console with capacities from 6 to 10 passengers. Jet ski rentals are also available on a first come first serve basis. Memberships and charter cruises with captain are offered.
extraNote: 48 hour cancellation policy for boat reservations · Credit card damage deposit required on all rentals · Boynton Harbor Marina, Ocean Avenue & Intracoastal Waterway
